phases.title: Survival
phases.goal: Read the Cyrillic alphabet and handle greetings, numbers, and a few survival phrases.
can: Read and write all 33 Cyrillic letters, including the vowel-reduction of unstressed о→'a'
Recognize the false friends (В=v, Н=n, Р=r, С=s, У=oo) that look Latin but aren't
Greet and introduce yourself: Здравствуйте, Меня зовут..., Очень приятно
Count 1–20 plus 100 and 1000 and read prices in rubles
Use да/нет, спасибо, пожалуйста, извините and основные survival phrases
Ask 'How much?' (Сколько стоит?) and 'Where is...?' (Где...?)
phases.daily: 20 min: alphabet tracing + reading street signs. 10 min: 5 greeting/number flashcards. 5 min: listen and repeat pronunciation aloud.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Form simple present-tense sentences and start the six-case system with nominative, accusative and prepositional.
can: Conjugate 1st- and 2nd-conjugation verbs in the present (читаю, говорю)
Drop 'to be' in the present and use есть/у меня есть for 'have'
Use the accusative for direct objects (feminine -а → -у)
Use the prepositional with в/на for location (в Москве, на столе)
Handle grammatical gender (m./f./n.) and match adjective endings
Ask and answer basic questions with кто, что, где, когда
phases.daily: 15 min: verb-conjugation drills. 15 min: vocab (colors, family, food). 10 min: read a short graded dialogue and translate it aloud.

phases.title: Core Structures
phases.goal: Master the remaining cases, verb aspect, and past/future tenses for everyday conversation.
can: Use the genitive for possession, absence (нет + gen.), and after 2/3/4 vs 5+
Use the dative (мне нравится) and instrumental (работать врачом, с другом)
Choose imperfective vs perfective aspect for process vs completed action
Form the past tense with gender agreement (-л/-ла/-ло/-ли)
Form both futures: буду + infinitive and the perfective simple future
Use verbs of motion идти/ходить, ехать/ездить correctly
phases.daily: 20 min: case-ending practice with a declension table. 15 min: aspect pairs and past-tense storytelling. 10 min: shadow a native audio clip.

phases.title: Fluency
phases.goal: Speak in connected paragraphs using complex clauses, comparisons, and reported speech.
can: Link ideas with который, потому что, чтобы, and хотя
Form comparatives (-ее) and superlatives (самый), including лучше/хуже
Use imperatives (Читай!, Говорите) for requests and instructions
Use conditional/subjunctive with бы for 'would' and unreal 'if'
Handle reflexive verbs (-ся) and possessive свой correctly
Follow and use obligatory double negation (никто не..., никогда не...)
phases.daily: 25 min: converse or journal on one topic. 15 min: watch Russian video with subtitles. 10 min: learn 10 new words in context sentences.

phases.title: Mastery
phases.goal: Approach native-like nuance with participles, verbal adverbs, stylistic register, and idiom.
can: Use present/past participles (читающий, прочитанный) in written Russian
Use verbal adverbs (читая, прочитав) for simultaneous and prior actions
Switch register between formal вы-style and colloquial speech
Understand aspectual and prefixal nuance across verb families (за-, пере-, до-)
Grasp idioms, proverbs, and cultural allusions in literature and news
Write structured essays and letters with correct stress and punctuation
phases.daily: 30 min: read unadapted literature or news, noting participles/idioms. 20 min: write and self-correct a paragraph. 10 min: discuss abstract topics with a partner or tutor.
